name: Baked Paneer Kofta
ingredients: 1 green chilli and 1 tsp ginger, minced
½ tsp cumin and ½ tsp coriander powder
steps: Mix the paneer, potato, besan, chilli, ginger, garam masala and salt; shape into 8 small balls.
Bake at 200°C for 18 minutes, turning once, until golden.
Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, and cook the blended tomato-onion with the spices for 10 minutes.
Add 1 cup water and simmer for 6 minutes.
Add the koftas and simmer for 2 minutes. Finish with coriander.
note: Baking replaces deep-frying the koftas; the potato binds them with less paneer.
